title: Wc build stops because the cut Coulomb is not positive definite
symptom: LibRPA aborts the GW step with 'the matrix is not positive definite info:1' at epsilon_solver_coulwc while use_cholesky_gw_wc is enabled.
evidence_required: the LibRPA switch value from the staged librpa.in
the cut-Coulomb spectrum (v1_coulomb_cut_iq_*) and the failing q index
the stage log line naming epsilon_solver_coulwc
the basis/ABFS identities of the run

candidate_experiments.action: turn off the Cholesky factorisation of Wc
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: removes the requirement that the truncated Coulomb be positive definite, which is not guaranteed by construction
candidate_experiments.guard: do not clip or shift cut-Coulomb eigenvalues; do not switch the full-Coulomb construction to hide the cut-family indefiniteness

candidate_experiments.action: inspect the cut-Coulomb eigen-spectrum before LibRPA and record the decision
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: separates an indefinite cut family from a corrupt or mis-indexed matrix so the switch is data-driven
candidate_experiments.guard: a PASS on the full-Coulomb PSD gate does not authorize Cholesky for Wc; they are different matrix families

stop_condition: The GW stage completes with the cut-Coulomb decision recorded, or the cut-Coulomb inputs are shown to be corrupt.

sources.ref: conversation 2026-10-27: cut coulomb 不正定就提前关掉 cholesky，否则开启
